name: ScalePostBot
description: ScalePost's on-demand fetcher. The operator documents that it fetches a publicly available page with a single GET request when a customer asks for an analysis of how that content is being crawled, cited and referenced by AI systems, that it does not execute JavaScript, submit forms or follow links out of the page body, and that it retains only extracted metadata. ScalePost states it fetches robots.txt before any URL on a host and obeys both its own token and the wildcard, honours Crawl-Delay across its parallel workers, and backs off on Retry-After.
